title: model-proximity-index-and-scouting-playbook
creator: Alex Vargas
description: Create a repeatable Playbook and scoring index (Model Proximity Index - MPI) to rank third-party models for Redwood integration and go/no-go prioritization. The MPI should combine technical fit, cost/perf signals, licensing risk, regional availability, and supply velocity. Outcome: a lightweight dashboard + CSV export + recommended triage rules for PM/Eng intake.
background: We routinely evaluate many open and commercial models. Current handoffs are ad-hoc and bias toward models with marketing momentum. Engineering capacity to onboard models is limited; we need a structured prioritization mechanism that codifies product need, integration cost, and commercial risk. This will reduce wasted onboarding effort and highlight high-impact short-path candidates.
goal: Deliver a validated Model Proximity Index and a documented scouting playbook that PMs and research engineers can use to score models and create repeatable intake decisions. Ship an initial dashboard and a 3-month cadence for telemetry-backed updates to scores.
scope: Design intake form and data fields for scouting
Prototype scoring pipeline (CSV + small script) and dashboard mock
Run scoring on 50 candidate models (open + commercial) to validate distribution
Produce triage rules for immediate onboarding vs. watchlist
methodology: Data sources: model repos (Hugging Face), vendor docs, license scans, benchmark suites, cost estimates from infra, regional availability mapping
Quantitative signals: latency/throughput delta (estimate), token quality from eval sets, inference cost per 1M tokens, quantization friendliness
Qualitative signals: license restrictiveness (open/commercial), model roadmap clarity, community momentum
Supply signals: packaging availability (ONNX/ggml/torchscript), container images, precompiled artifacts for target GPU stacks
Validation: blind scoring on 50 models and cross-check with internal eng effort estimates for three pilot integrations
scoring_rubric: Technical Fit (0-30): architecture compatibility, memory profile, KV/cache friendliness
Performance/Cost (0-25): expected tokens/sec, quantization path, cost per 1M tokens
Licensing & Compliance (0-20): permissive, copyleft, commercial license, export controls
Operational Readiness (0-15): prebuilt containers, multi-precision weights, reproducible builds
Strategic Fit (0-10): vertical signals, partner opportunities, unique capabilities (e.g., code/structured output)
Total score scaled to 0-100 and banded: >=80 (High priority), 60-79 (Watchlist), 40-59 (Low priority), <40 (Archive)
Weighting is configurable per product vertical; default weights above assigned for general purpose inference
deliverables: Playbook doc: intake -> scoring -> triage -> engineering handoff
Dashboard mock showing top candidates, score breakdowns, and regional availability
Initial scored cohort of 50 models and raw data export
acceptance_criteria: Playbook reviewed and approved by PM, Research, and 2 Eng leads
Scoring pipeline reproducible: run on new model in <2 hours (manual data pull)
Dashboard mock validated by at least 3 stakeholder interviews
Pilot: 3 models from High priority band successfully onboarded to dev infra with effort estimate within +/-25% of predicted
